videoTitle: You're Buying the Wrong Amount of Chicken (Here's the Math You Need)
videoDescription: You know your macro targets, but how much raw chicken or rice do you actually need to buy for the week? Turns out the answer isn't intuitive—cooking changes weight dramatically, and most of us are guessing wrong. Learn the yield-factor method that ends the guesswork. Full breakdown at mindtivate.com
script: You've been calculating your grocery list wrong. A pound of raw chicken breast loses 25% of its weight when you cook it—so if you need 565 grams of cooked chicken for the week, you actually have to buy...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
